notes: Builds a per-participant clinical-skill-domain dataset by averaging groups of pre/post survey items (communication, exam, treatment, clinical reasoning, knowledge, procedural) via mean() over macro-variable-supplied column lists, with a conditional branch skipping procedural-skill averaging for one named project; unmodified logic. Substituted a 3-row mock RedPrePostWide with two pre/post items per domain, and set the six PreXxxc/PostXxxc macro variables directly to the matching column-name lists that _macro_vars_clin_cats.sas would have produced via PROC SQL from a network-hosted question catalog.
